readAuthority.noCanaryReason: a partial read is not a meaningful state; only the full d1 read is offered
readAuthority.independenceRationale: a write canary must never silently change what a reader sees; separating the authorities makes the read cutover an explicit, individually reversible operator action

nodeGithubReader.d1Path: readOpsHeartbeatsViaBoundary -> authenticated GET /v1/ops/heartbeats on the existing worldcons-ops-write boundary

cloudflareRuntimeReader.d1Path: runtime slot from worker/index.ts (WORLDCONS_OPS_HEARTBEAT_READ_AUTHORITY) preferred over process.env; direct isolated WORLDCONS_OPS D1 binding, no HTTP hop

boundary.d1Query: SELECT workflow_key, last_started_at, last_completed_at, last_status, run_id FROM ops_workflow_heartbeats WHERE workflow_key IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

failClosed.selectedD1Unavailable: throws (503 at the boundary); never silently falls back to Supabase

parity.defensiveRowFilter: unknown key, missing start timestamp, invalid status are dropped

preservedAuthority.rollback: set WORLDCONS_OPS_HEARTBEAT_READ_AUTHORITY=supabase (restores the local Supabase read); no schema/data change

liveReadPrerequisites: deploy worldcons-ops-write with read authority resting at supabase; confirm GET /v1/ops/heartbeats returns 401 without the bearer
deploy the main Worker with read authority resting at supabase
set repo var WORLDCONS_OPS_HEARTBEAT_READ_AUTHORITY=d1 and the boundary Worker read var=d1; confirm the boundary read returns the same five-field records as the Supabase reader
confirm ordinary Node/GitHub and Cloudflare readers now read D1
roll the read authority back to supabase and confirm the local read resumes
blockers: no Cloudflare/DB credential access in this environment; controller owns the live read parity proof
admin_ops_events remains deferred to M11.4 (read-before-write dedupe + prune contract)
M11 not globally complete: ingest and core/publication remain pending
